title: State SC Scholarship Classes 1-5 (Girls) and 6-8
eligibility: SC girls in Classes 1-5 and SC students in Classes 6-8
benefits: Official record lists scholarship amounts by class/category; payment is directly to the student's bank account.
documents_required: Verified copy of permanent caste certificate
MP domicile/self-declaration documents as specified in the official record
application_process: Eligible student profile is entered by the school on the Shiksha Portal.
important_sections_or_clauses: Renewal requirements differ by class group as specified in the official record.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
